title: Driving school pack with huge red numerals, pink blocks and blue maze-squiggle patterns

whatItMeans: Graphic and playful; bold numbers and road-like squiggles make lessons feel modern.
techniques: Use giant numerals as a graphic element.
Mix line stripes and squiggle patterns as blocks.
